title: Buddhakathā
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Atthi buddhānaṁ buddhehi hīnātirekatāti? Āmantā. Satipaṭṭhānatoti? Na hevaṁ vattabbe …pe… sammappadhānato …pe… iddhipādato … indriyato … balato … bojjhaṅgato … vasibhāvato …pe… sabbaññutañāṇadassanatoti? Na hevaṁ vattabbe …pe…. Buddhakathā niṭṭhitā.
